exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0 or 1 or Karnofsky Performance Scale (KPS) ≥ 70
Any malignancy ≤ 2 years before first dose of study drug except for the specific cancer under investigation in this study and any locally recurring cancer that has been treated curatively

QT interval corrected by Fridericia's method (QTcF) \> 470 ms based on the screening triplicate 12-lead ECG records and/or a history of additional risk factors for torsade de pointes (eg, heart failure, hypokalemia, or a family history of Long QT Syndrome)
Active leptomeningeal disease or symptomatic spinal cord compression
Female participants who are pregnant or are breastfeeding
